The '''Daimla system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Kallea sector/Legends|Kallea sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] containing the [[Daimlo]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Daimla]].
